raw.details:
Overview

A national-level 24-hour coding challenge organised by the CSI Student Chapter under TECHNEX-26 at SVPCET, Nagpur, on 19-20 December 2026. It is open to undergraduate students from across India, who work in teams on real-world problem statements.

The event aims to encourage innovation and problem-solving by bringing together talented undergraduate students from across India. Participants will apply their technical knowledge, creativity, and skills to develop innovative solutions to real-world, industry-based problems.

Eligibility & Team Formation

  • Open to undergraduate students across India (B.Tech, B.E., BCA and B.Sc.).
  • Team size must be 3–5 members.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialisation participation will be governed by registration guidelines.
  • Only registered team members are permitted to participate.

Competition Format

The competition consists of the following rounds:

Round 1: Online Ideation & PPT Submission

  • Mode: Online.
  • Participants must submit a PPT explaining their proposed solution.
  • The presentation should include the problem statement, proposed solution, tools and technologies, feasibility and impact.
  • Top 50 teams will qualify for Round 2.

Round 2: 24-Hour On-Campus Hackathon

  • Mode: Offline at SVPCET, Nagpur.
  • Teams will receive a new industry-based problem statement 12 hours before the on-campus round.
  • Participants must develop a working solution within 24 hours.
  • Final submission includes a working prototype, GitHub repository and final presentation.

Submission Guidelines

Round 1:

  • The problem statements (PS) for Round 1 will be released on 26th November.
  • Teams must prepare their PPT based on the released problem statements.
  • The PPT must strictly follow the presentation format and guidelines that will be provided by the organising committee.
  • Optional YouTube video explaining the proposed solution.

Round 2:

  • Working project prototype.
  • GitHub repository link containing project code.
  • Detailed final presentation.
  • Live demonstration of the developed solution.

Rules & Regulations

  • All submissions must be original and developed by registered team members.
  • Plagiarism, copied projects and fraudulent submissions are strictly prohibited.
  • Round 2 project code must be developed during the event.
  • Significant third-party and open-source components must be disclosed.
  • Participants must follow all event guidelines and instructions.
  • All submissions must be completed within the specified deadlines.
  • Late submissions may be penalised or rejected.

Offline Participation Rules

  • Round 2 will be conducted offline at St. Vincent Pallotti College of Engineering and Technology (SVPCET), Nagpur.
  • Participants must attend the on-campus round at the designated venue.
  • Teams must follow the venue rules and safety guidelines.
  • Participants must cooperate with organisers during verification and evaluation.

Hybrid Participation Rules

  • Round 1 will be conducted entirely online.
  • Round 2 will be conducted offline at SVPCET, Nagpur.
  • Participants must follow the submission guidelines and instructions applicable to their respective rounds.
  • Teams qualifying for Round 2 must be available for the 24-hour on-campus hackathon.
